items.title: CAT Shares Fall Despite Q3 Earnings Beat: How to Play the Stock?
items.summary: CAT's Q3 earnings beat estimates, but unchanged 2026 guidance and a premium valuation weigh on shares. Is it a Buy, Sell or Hold?

items.title: Liz Ann Sonders Says “Rotation Is the New Momentum Trade.” Here’s Where Money Could Move Next
items.summary: The AI trade is still running, but Wall Street's sharpest strategist says the real action has moved elsewhere. One industrial darling just dropped nearly 30% in a month, proving that the next safe harbor may not be safe at all.

items.title: The Dow Just Jumped 1,569 Points for Its Best Post-Midterm Day in 44 Years
items.summary: Relief, cheaper oil and a calmer VIX sent Wall Street soaring after the midterms, yet no major index hit a record, and one fund quietly did. Which one reveals the rally's real story, and what could unravel it?
